newsitem.title: UK: LME copper bid lower in evening session.
newsitem.headline: LME copper bid lower in evening session.

text.p: London copper extended kerb losses on Monday evening while aluminium was indicated higher.
Three-month copper was bid down to $2,166 a tonne initially but recouped to $2,173 at the close, representing a loss of $4 on the kerb, which was down $9 from Friday.
The cash-threes backwardation was unchanged at $170/180 after having moved out during the kerb from Friday's close of $225.
Traders said an expected rise in stocks on Tuesday had weighed on copper.

Rudolf Wolff expected a further weakening in the cash-threes spread "However, once the back has narrowed further, we expect the strong economic demand being experienced in most regions to stimulate increased trade buying," it said in a daily commentary, pegging the nearby support at $2,140 and $2,220-30.
Aluminium was indicated at $1,629 a tonne, up $3 from the kerb.
